paper.title_en: A relation between the HOMFLY-PT and Kauffman polynomials via characters
paper.abstract_en: The HOMFLY-PT and Kauffman polynomials are related to each other for special classes of knots constructed by full twists and Jucys-Murphy twists. The conditions for this relation are articulated in terms of characters of the Birman-Murakami-Wenzl algebra. The latter are the coefficients in the expansion of the Kauffman polynomial involving the quantum dimensions of SO(N+1). This expansion allows to prove the conjectural 1-1 correspondence between the HOMFLY-PT/Kauffman relation and the Harer-Zagier (HZ) factorisability for a large family of 3-strand knots. The conjecture remains open for knots with 4 and higher strands.
